Instructions for Use
Device description: The Helix Aneurysm Clip is a intracranial aneurysm clip. It is available in lengths from 15 mm to 38 mm.
Warnings: For single use only. Do not resterilize. Store at 15 °C to 30 °C.
Refer to the surgical technique guide for implantation instructions.

MRI Safety Information
The Helix Aneurysm Clip is MR Conditional. Patients with this device can be scanned at 1.5 T or 3.0 T when all of the following conditions are met.
General conditions:
- Maximum spatial field gradient of 2,500 gauss/cm.
- Gradient slew rate ≤ 200 T/m/s (per axis).
- Use the body transmit coil.
- WB-SAR ≤ 0.1 W/kg.
- head SAR ≤ 3.2 W/kg.
- Limit total active scanning to 10 min.
The image artifact extends approximately 2 mm from the device.
RF heating was evaluated using a body coil at 64 MHz and 128 MHz in a gel phantom.
